input.definition: Liquid water changes into water vapor when it gains heat.
Water vapor cools and changes into liquid water droplets.
Flowing water or wind carries rock and soil away to another place.
Water or wind drops the sediment it has carried at a new location.
Earth spins around its axis, causing day and night.
Earth travels around the Sun in an orbit once each year.
Heat transfers through direct contact between neighboring particles.
Heat transfers as warmer fluid rises and cooler fluid sinks.
